verdict.rationale: The only first-party sign of a mobile app is a single mention of scanning text with the camera on mobile (trello-docs-31), and there is no documented claim of desktop parity. Hands-on community feedback (old, 2011-era) says the iPhone app was 'very far from their web interface' and an order of magnitude less usable, and another user noted no Android app at the time. missing for 10: first-party documentation of native iOS/Android apps and their feature set, evidence of feature parity with desktop/web, current independent corroboration of mobile usability.
